services.name: Jet Skis
services.desc: ALL LOCATIONS ARE NOW WEEKENDS ONLY! :( While we are no longer accepting jetski walk ups on weekdays, skii reservations can still be made online and we will be there to get you out! Dismiss Please arrive 30 minutes early for your rental to do your paperwork and check in. We offer a fleet of Sea-Doo GTX 130 Jet Skis in Baltimore. These are the highest horsepower skis in the area for rent. You will be required to take a quick DNR test with or without an existing Boaters Safety Card. We encourage everyone to take the free Boat US Course and will accept this course within 15 days of your rental. You can find the course here: https://www.boatus.org/maryland/ All operators must be at least 18
